overall_notes:
Response consists of a single mobile photograph of the vendor's standard printed September 2026 rate list, with two handwritten annotations. It is NOT a structured bid against RFQ NHPC/PKG/RFQ/2026/047: no questionnaire responses (Q02, Q03, Q04, Q06, Q07, Q11, Q12 entirely unanswered), no ISO certificate or any other document attached, no GSM/BF board specifications, and sizes given in inches with no statement of whether they are internal or external dimensions (RFx specifies INTERNAL). Matching to RFx lines was done by converting inches to mm (1 in = 25.4 mm) and comparing ply and print level; matches are close but not exact (e.g. 7.75x6x4 in = 197x152x102 mm vs L01 200x150x100 mm).

IMPORTANT DATA-QUALITY WARNING: the photograph is taken at an angle and the ITEM, SIZE, PLY, RATE and PER columns are visibly skewed relative to each other, so for the middle and lower part of the list the pairing of item name to size to rate is uncertain. Lines L09, L10, L18, L19, L21, L22, L23, L26 and L28 carry reduced extraction confidence for this reason and should be re-confirmed with the vendor in writing before evaluation. Where my line-level 'price' field conflicts with the verbatim snippet, the snippet governs; see the notes on L02 (5.70), L07 (40.60) and L10 (27.05).

Commercial deviations vs RFx: payment 30 days (vs 45 requested); validity only till 31-10-2026 (~38 days vs 180 required); rates subject to change without notice per paper market (no firm price); printing block/die charges extra at actuals (affects all printed lines L03-L08, L13-L16, L24-L26); transport free only 'within Bhiwandi' - buyer warehouse is at Bhiwandi so likely delivered-free, but should be confirmed in writing.

Not quoted: L16 (shelf-ready tray - vendor asks buyer to call), L29 (die-cut insert, new item), L30 (bulk bin with lid). L28 (HSC) status unclear. Rolls L21/L22 quoted per KG, not per roll, so landed per-roll cost cannot be computed without roll weights.
